spec.assertion: S1 must trigger on fullBurstEnter (structural) and emit NO buffApply from mary in run A, where 3+ Full Bursts occur but mary never casts. Fails under the nearest-wrong that re-keys it to burstCast (structural check) or that encodes the HoT as a stat grant (buffApply appears in A).
Structural: target.kind === 'allies' with no excludeSelf. Fails under the nearest-wrong that leaks S2's Water-Code scope onto S1, or that excludes the caster.
Exactly one `escalating` effect holding 3 heal steps. Fails under a single flat heal (escalating count 0) or under 3 independent blocks that would all fire on the first FB entry.

Every heal step carries ticks === 5 and intervalSec === 1 (5 recovery emissions, not one instant heal). Fails under ticks:1 — the encoding that silently starves any teammate's on-recovery trigger of 4 of its 5 firings.
it.skip — v1 models no HP pool, so the healed amount is unobservable; only tick count + target set are testable. Flagged rather than silently dropped.

Zero elemAdvantageDamagePct applies in run A (mary never casts; liter takes the B1 window) while >=3 Full Bursts occur, and >=3 apply-waves in run B (mary casts). This is the failure-mode-#3 discriminator: a fullBurstEnter-keyed model fires in A and goes RED.

The S2 target set is a STRICT subset of the burst's all-allies set and contains mary. Fails under target 'allies' (sets become equal — the fixture is asserted to contain a non-Water ally so this is non-vacuous).
Cast 1 emits exactly {20.85}, cast 2 {20.85,13.88}, cast 3+ all three, each value once per Water ally. Fails under (a) all-tiers-every-cast and (b) tier-replacement-not-cumulative.
Within one cast, expiresFrame offsets are exactly +120 (tier2−tier1) and +300 (tier3−tier2) frames. Fails under any shared/rounded duration, which is the over-crediting encoding for the short tiers.

Zeroing the stat drops mary's damage (Fire boss ⇒ Water advantage satisfied ⇒ the buff is live, not inert) while leaving every non-Water ally byte-identical. Fails if the line is dropped as defensive or filed in a bucket the Water carriers don't read.

Its target set equals the S2 Water set exactly; zeroing burst-slot atkPct lowers mary's damage and leaves non-Water allies unmoved. Fails under casterAtkPct (patch becomes a no-op) and under an all-allies target.

spec.kitLine: All allies: Max HP ▲27.87% of user
spec.assertion: Emitted as maxHpFlat with an IDENTICAL value to every ally (caster-scaled) and a superset target set vs the Water lines; expiry sits exactly 7 s (420 f) past the 3 s ATK buff of the same cast. Fails under targetMaxHpPct (per-ally values differ across Supporter/Defender/Attacker) and under a Water-only target.
Zeroing it leaves the whole comp's per-slug totals byte-identical (ally-granted Max HP feeds no teammate ATK conversion). Fails if it were mis-encoded as atkOfMaxHpPct or a plain ATK buff.

fixtures: Two runs of controlComp('mary-bay-goddess', true) (liter B1 / crown B2 / mary / helm B3, Fire boss) plus three counterfactual arms — 5 sims total. The Fire boss is load-bearing: Water allies hold elemental advantage, so S2's elemAdvantageDamagePct is live rather than inert. Run A is the shipped fixture — mary is Burst I and liter (slot 0) is also Burst I, so liter wins every B1 window and mary never casts; that silence is exactly what discriminates 'when USING Burst Skill' from 'when entering Full Burst'. Run B adds a fixture-only {kind:'burstFirst'} passive block to mary's burst slot so she takes the B1 window and all burst-cast lines fire; the patch alters burst SELECTION only — no magnitude, duration, target or trigger — so it cannot manufacture a pass. B_noElem / B_noAtk / B_noHp are B with a single stat zeroed, giving the damage-path and inertness deltas. helm=true is required: without a Burst III the comp makes ZERO Full Bursts and every S1 assertion would be vacuous.
gaps: S1 heal magnitudes (1.05% / 3.69% / 6.86% of the caster's final Max HP) — it.skip: v1 models no HP pool, so the healed amount is structurally unobservable; the test pins the tick count (5×1 s), the escalation shape and the all-allies target instead.

S1 heal → teammate on-recovery consumer — it.skip: `heal` emits no event kind of its own (the onEvent stream has no 'recovery' kind), so the tandem channel is observable only through an ally whose kit carries a `recovery` trigger; asserting it blind would test the teammate's override, not mary's, so it is deferred until a fixture with a confirmed recovery consumer is pinned.

FIXTURE PREMISE, flagged not silently assumed: run A's discriminating power rests on liter (slot 0, Burst I) winning the B1 window over mary every rotation, and run B's on {kind:'burstFirst'} overriding that selection. Both are asserted explicitly in the first test, so if either premise is wrong the failure localizes to the fixture rather than being read as a kit-faithfulness defect.
